Routines

top source red_round

SST pipeline

result = red_round(x [, n_digits=integer] [, n_decimals=integer])

Round x to # of digits or # of decimals.

Return value

Parameters

x in type=number

Keywords

n_digits in optional type=integer

The number of digits to preserve. If no decimals, return an integer.

n_decimals in optional type=integer

The number of decimals to preserve. If negative, return an integer with the -n_decimals least significant digits set to zero.
